It is completely normal to be curious about sexuality at your age, and many people start exploring these topics in middle school. However, feeling guilty often happens when we know we are crossing a boundary set by the people who care about us. Your parents' rules are likely there to protect you, as some online videos can be overwhelming or give an unrealistic picture of relationships. While your curiosity itself isn't wrong, sneaking around can make that heavy feeling of guilt much worse. 

You don't need to feel ashamed of wanting to learn, but it is important to be safe online. If you have questions about growing up or relationships, consider talking to a trusted adult, like a school counselor, a health teacher, or an older family member. They can help you find age-appropriate, accurate information so you can understand your feelings without the stress of hiding things.
